_doc: Single source of truth for life areas. Python (lifeos/domains.py) and the web app (app/lifeos.html via scripts/build_app.py) both read this. Areas are checked in order; first keyword hit wins. Keywords are regex fragments, matched as whole words, case-insensitive.

areas.label: Ideas
areas.covers: Startup and side-project ideas, shower thoughts, things to try
examples: what if gyms rented by the hour
areas.tip: Ideas resurface in your weekly review so they don't die in notes.

areas.label: Pets
areas.covers: Vet visits, vaccines, deworming, flea/tick meds, food stock, grooming, walks, weight
areas.tip: Log each dose once with 'every N days' and it rolls forward forever.

areas.label: Vehicle
areas.covers: Servicing, NCT, motor tax, insurance renewal, PUC, FASTag/tolls, fuel, tyres, fines
areas.tip: Add insurance and PUC expiry once; you'll be nudged ahead of time.

areas.label: Kids & school
areas.covers: School fees, PTMs, exams, homework, tuition, vaccinations, activities
areas.tip: Term fees can repeat: 'school fees every 3 months'.

areas.label: Travel
areas.covers: Flights, trains, hotels, packing, web check-in, trip plans
areas.tip: Trips show two weeks ahead so you can book and pack in time.

areas.label: Documents & IDs
areas.covers: Passport, visa, IRP/GNIB residence permit, PPSN, licence, insurance policies, certificates, warranties
areas.tip: Store only expiry dates, never document numbers. Rent agreements get a 60-day heads-up.

areas.label: Family & friends
areas.covers: Birthdays, anniversaries, calls home, parents' needs, gifts, catch-ups
areas.tip: Birthdays show a week ahead so there's time for a gift.

areas.label: Work & career
areas.covers: Meetings, deadlines, interviews, clients, invoices, appraisals, job search
areas.tip: Freelance? 'invoice X every month' keeps cash flowing.

areas.label: Home
areas.covers: Rent, society maintenance, repairs, appliances and servicing, house help, groceries, gas, utility bills
areas.tip: Rent, maintenance and servicing can all repeat: 'ac service every 6 months'.

areas.label: Money
areas.covers: EMIs, SIPs, credit card dues, taxes/ITR, salary, lending, spending, subscriptions
examples: credit card bill due 5th every month
areas.tip: Type 'spent 450 on X' and the weekly review totals it.

areas.label: Health & fitness
areas.covers: Doctor and dentist visits, medicines, tests, gym, runs, sleep, steps, water, weight, BP, sugar
areas.tip: Log sleep, steps or runs in plain words; trends show in the weekly review.

areas.label: Mind & mood
areas.covers: Mood, stress, gratitude, therapy, meditation, how you feel
areas.tip: A daily 'mood N' builds your weekly mood line.

areas.label: Learning & goals
areas.covers: Books, courses, skills, habits, goals, language practice
areas.tip: Habits work best as 'X daily'; mark done each day to keep the streak.

areas.label: Orders & shopping
areas.covers: Deliveries, return windows, refunds, wishlists, things to buy
areas.tip: Add the return deadline so you don't miss the window.

areas.label: Fun & plans
areas.covers: Movies, parties, weddings, matches, dinners out, hobbies
areas.tip: Plans with friends count toward a balanced week.

areas.label: Calendar
areas.covers: Appointments and events that don't fit elsewhere
areas.tip: Anything with a date lands here if no other area fits.

fallback.label: Journal
fallback.covers: Everything else: thoughts, notes, life log
fallback.tip: Write freely; prefix 'journal:' to force it here.

lead_overrides.why: many countries require 6+ months passport validity to enter
Irish permission renewals open 12 weeks before expiry
NCT slots book up weeks ahead

guides.title: Renew your IRP
steps: Renewals open 12 weeks before expiry. Apply on that day: processing has been taking 17+ weeks.
Apply online, and only while you are in Ireland.
Upload everything in one go: passport, current IRP card, proof of address and the documents your stamp needs. Missing documents stop the application.
Keep the confirmation email. The new card comes by post after approval.

guides.title: Book your NCT
steps: Book online as soon as you can: slots can be weeks away.
Bring your driving licence and the vehicle registration cert on the day.
Driving without a valid NCT means fines and penalty points.

guides.title: Renew motor tax
steps: Renew online with the PIN on your renewal reminder.
You can usually choose 3, 6 or 12 months.

guides.title: Driving licence
steps: Book an NDLS appointment early; slots fill up.
Bring your PPSN, proof of address and current licence or permit.

guides.title: Renew your passport
steps: Many countries need 6+ months left on your passport to let you in, so renew early.
Indian passport: apply through Passport Seva for applicants abroad, then follow the embassy's instructions.
Irish passport: renew online with Passport Online.

guides.title: PPSN and welfare
steps: Your PPSN is on payslips and Revenue letters.
Use MyWelfare to request or check your PPSN and services.

guides.title: Tax and credits
steps: Check your tax credits in Revenue myAccount.
Renting? Claim the rent tax credit in myAccount.
Keep receipts for medical expenses: you can claim relief on them.

guides.title: Renting
steps: Your landlord must register the tenancy with the RTB.
Disputes about deposits or rent go to the RTB.

guides.title: Health insurance renewal
steps: Compare plans before the renewal date: you can switch at renewal.
Check your waiting periods carry over when switching.

guides.title: Car insurance renewal
steps: Get 2 or 3 quotes before the renewal date.
Ask your insurer for your no-claims bonus certificate when switching.
